values.f_sentinel: earliest game of each ET game day; the rest of that day's games are checked only once the sentinel shows props

key_out.effect: that team's legs in the same room may not have a model-vs-market gap over news_gap, in any state (the book has priced the absence; our model has not)

room_change.effect: a WR/TE/RB with target_share+ of his team's targets or carry_share+ of its carries over his last lookback_games games for that team joins a new team or leaves one: no new picks (over or under) in that team's same room (key_out.rooms) until the team has played team_games_after games since the change. Join: rows or the weekly roster put him on a new team; it clears once he has played team_games_after games for it (or the team has played max_wait_team_games games since his last old-team game without him playing). Leave: he has rows for another team after his last game for this one, is on another team's roster, is off every weekly roster (cut, released, traded), or his roster status is in leave_statuses (RES = IR, PUP, NFI); clears once his old team has played team_games_after games since his last game for it. A weekly Out is not a leave. Shown picks in the room are pulled.

qb_change.markets: all of that team's player markets
qb_change.questionable_starter: no new overs for that team until inactives confirm him active

weather.source: open-meteo hourly wind_speed_10m at the kickoff hour, wind_speed_unit=mph, stadium lat/lon

values.line_move: pull (code line_moved, reason 'Hard Rock moved the line to X'); the new line is a fresh candidate with its own id and must qualify on its own

grading.dnp: void (no offensive snap and no stat)
grading.price: worst price shown while open (a price that triggered a pull was never shown)
grading.parlay: all legs win = win at the parlay's worst shown snapshot; any loss = loss; a void/push leg drops out and the parlay is repriced from the remaining legs' graded prices; one leg left = graded as that single
grading.anytime_td: rush + rec + return/fumble-recovery TDs (not passing TDs) (display only in v1)
grading.long_no_catch: 0 yards (under wins) if he played and had no catch/carry: verify Hard Rock house rule
grading.pulled: graded too, shown separately, never counted in the hit rate
grading.when: after ESPN marks the game final, from nflverse play-by-play (next morning); ESPN box score fallback for full-game stats if nflverse is 36h+ late

questionable.new_picks: none for that game, even if he is later active (2026: Questionable players who played hit 16 of 31 picks rated 69%)
questionable.shown_pick: pulled when he is listed Questionable or worse (code injury)

values.inactives_source: ESPN game summary/roster for that event (Builder to confirm the exact field from the runner); confirmed = both teams list inactives_min_per_team+ inactives
values.refit: DS may refit model_params weekly (Tue) on new games; shrink and every value here change only by the sample rule
values.missed_last: missed his team's last game (any reason) -> no new pick until state is injury or later and he carries no designation
values.stats_behind: nflverse rows missing the team's most recent game -> no new picks for that team; page names the team
values.inactives_rule: state 'inactives' when ESPN lists inactives_min_per_team+ inactives for BOTH teams, checked from inactives_earliest_min before kickoff. Not confirmed by inactives_deadline_min before kickoff: picks stay 'injury', no new pick that needs 'inactives', page says 'Inactives not confirmed yet', and they lock as 'locked_unconfirmed'.
values.drift_applies: until inactives confirmed (states early and injury)
values.near_pick: passes every eligibility rule and margin >= near_pick_margin; used only to choose what pull C re-checks

text: Every pick needs a real Hard Rock price of -200 or better, up to +120. Plus money is fine.
Full game markets we pick: receptions, receiving yards, rushing yards, carries, rush + rec yards, passing yards, passing tds, interceptions, longest catch, longest run.
1st half markets we pick: passing yards, receiving yards, rushing yards.
Our chance mixes our model (60%) with Hard Rock's own price (40%). The model's number is trimmed a little first, more for markets it reads less well.

We only pick when our model gives at least 62%, our chance is at least 57%, and it beats the price's the price needs (what it takes to break even) by 4 points early, 3 once the injury report is in, 2 once inactives are in.
No pick on a player listed questionable or worse at any point this week, or who missed his team's last game until the injury report clears him.
No overs on a player with fewer than 8 recent games, a new team, or a new starting QB.
No pick either way on a player whose role swings a lot from game to game.
When a receiver or back with a big share of his team's targets or carries joins or leaves a team, that team's receiving or rushing picks wait 2 games.
No new pick from a Hard Rock price more than 6 hours old.
No passing or deep-catch overs in wind of 15 mph or more at kickoff.
At most 1 pick per player, 2 per team and 3 per game.
1st half spreads show DraftKings numbers for reference. They are never picks.
A pick is pulled if the player is ruled out or inactive, the price goes past -200, or the line moves or comes down.
Parlays are 2 or 3 legs from the top picks, each leg in a different game, up to 2 a game day, each pick in at most 1.
Picks lock at kickoff. Results come from the official stats once the game is final.
The Record grades every pick at the worst Hard Rock price shown, 1 unit each. Pulled picks are graded too and shown as pulled.

messages.not_yet: Hard Rock hasn't posted player props for this game yet. Next check %s.
messages.main_only: Main lines only for this game (odds credits are low).
messages.not_pulled: No Hard Rock prices pulled for this game (odds credits are low).
messages.keys_low: Odds credits are running low: some games get main lines only.

ui.reason_rule: verb = 'clear' (over) / 'stay under' (under). why_2 (opponent or team-total clause) is dropped when the sentence would pass reason_max_chars. Whole percents: chance rounded down, break-even rounded to nearest. No jargon, no em dashes.
